the Company’s ability to retain key clients and secure new client engagements, including realizing expected revenue from new contracts and personnel
the Company’s dependence on a limited number of significant clients, including concentration of sales and accounts receivable with individual customers
the Company’s ability to expand its Stran and SLS segments as planned and to realize the expected benefits of its strategic investments

the Company’s ability to manage its growth effectively and control operating expenses
the impact of general economic conditions, including inflation, supply chain disruptions, and changes in consumer and corporate spending

the Company’s ability to identify, complete, and successfully integrate acquisitions
